caseName: Hyam v. Upper Montgomery Joint Authority
caseNameFull: HYAM Et Al. v. UPPER MONTGOMERY JOINT AUTHORITY Et Al.
attorneys: Peyton Ford and J. Howard McGrath for appellants., Aloysius B. McCabe and Joseph DuCoeur for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
